patientProblems: Persistent cough for the past 3 weeks
Mild chest pain during deep breathing
uploadScan.reasoning: Abnormal opacity and slight inflammation detected in the right lower lung lobe. Findings may indicate early infection or localized fluid buildup.

report.findings: CT scan reveals a 2.5 cm spiculated solid nodule in the upper lobe of the right lung. No lymphadenopathy identified. Minor atelectasis noted at lung bases.

impressions.summary: Findings are highly suspicious for malignancy. Immediate clinical correlation recommended.

suggestions: Oncologist consultation for management of the suspicious lung nodule.
Biopsy of the lung nodule for histopathological diagnosis.
Cardiology consultation for coronary artery disease evaluation.
